title: A recipe change is a useful household memory
user_outcome: The user can later remember that the lentil soup worked better with lemon and less cumin.

steps.text: Next time for the lentil soup: add lemon at the end and use less cumin.

steps.question: How should I change the lentil soup next time?

manual_observations: A free-form cooking note should remain useful without being forced into a task or shopping category.

title: A Wi-Fi workaround should be retrievable
user_outcome: When the Wi-Fi problem returns, the user can recall that restarting the white mesh unit fixed it once.

steps.text: Wi-Fi kept dropping in the office; restarting the white mesh unit fixed it last time.

steps.question: What helped with the office Wi-Fi last time?

manual_observations: The system should preserve the detail as an observation, not claim that restarting always fixes the network.

title: Remember a gift idea for a friend
user_outcome: A later question about gifts for Priya retrieves the handmade ceramic mug idea without creating an unrequested purchase.

steps.text: Gift idea for Priya: a handmade ceramic mug with a blue glaze.

steps.question: What gift idea did I have for Priya?

manual_observations: A gift idea is memory until the user asks for a task or purchase action.

title: Store a shoe size from a casual conversation
user_outcome: The user can later ask Kuba's shoe size and receive EU 42 as a personal detail.

steps.text: Kuba wears EU 42 shoes, he mentioned it at lunch.

manual_observations: The detail should be retrievable even though it is neither a deadline nor a subscription.

title: Recall a small conversation detail
user_outcome: The user's later question recalls that Noor is moving to Bristol in June, without turning a conversation into an urgent task.

steps.text: Noor said she is moving to Bristol in June.

steps.question: What did Noor say about moving?

manual_observations: Conversation memory should not be lost simply because it lacks a predefined entity type.

title: Understand what a landlord PDF represents
user_outcome: The user can ask what the landlord document is and learn that it is the new lease, with the PDF retained as evidence.

steps.text: The PDF from the landlord is the new lease.

steps.question: What is the PDF from the landlord?

manual_observations: The answer should link to or clearly identify the attached source; a bare unsupported label is not enough.

title: Keep a pet-care observation
user_outcome: The user can later recall that the cat stopped eating the salmon treats after the new bag was opened, without an invented medical conclusion.

steps.text: The cat stopped eating the salmon treats after we opened the new bag.

steps.question: What did I notice about the cat and the salmon treats?

manual_observations: Do not infer an allergy, illness, or treatment from this observation alone.

title: Recall a travel detail without a booking form
user_outcome: The user can later remember that the quiet entrance to the Kraków apartment is through the courtyard, not the street door.

steps.text: W mieszkaniu w Krakowie ciche wejście jest od podwórka, nie od ulicy.

steps.question: Którędy wejść do mieszkania w Krakowie?

manual_observations: Place-specific travel knowledge should survive as memory even without importing a reservation.

title: Remember a household maintenance detail
user_outcome: The user can later recall that the downstairs radiator valve needs turning clockwise to stop the rattle, while the source remains available.

steps.text: The downstairs radiator rattles unless its valve is turned clockwise halfway.

steps.question: How did I stop the downstairs radiator rattling?

manual_observations: The product should distinguish a useful workaround from a confirmed repair or an automatically scheduled maintenance job.

title: Preserve a vague observation without overclaiming
user_outcome: The vague observation is findable later and is labeled as an observation, not promoted into a confirmed cause or urgent problem.

steps.text: There was a faint sweet smell near the back door this evening; I don't know why.

steps.question: What did I notice near the back door yesterday?

manual_observations: Missing cause must remain unknown; a useful recall answer can still quote the observation.
